description: Effective mail settings (the password is never returned)

host.description: The mail server (SMTP host name or IP address); empty when not set

security.description: How the connection is secured: starttls, tls (implicit TLS) or none. Default: starttls

verify_tls.description: Whether the server's certificate must be valid. Default: on

username.description: The login name; empty sends no login

from_address.description: The sender address of every mail; empty when not set

from_name.description: The sender name shown with the address; may be empty

reply_to.description: The address replies go to; may be empty

allow_password_reset.description: Whether users may reset a forgotten password by mail. It also needs mail set up and the public URL; turning it on without the public URL is refused. Default: off

password_set.description: Whether a password is saved or set by the environment. The password itself is never returned

secret_error.description: Whether the saved password cannot be decrypted (the encryption key changed); enter it again

locked.description: Fields set by environment variables (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the name of the environment variable that sets it. The name for password comes back blank (the API blanks every value under a key named password); locked is the source of truth and the variable is SMTP_PASSWORD

configured.description: Whether mail can be sent: the server and the sender address are set

config_errors.description: Fields whose effective value the sender refuses (a restored row or an env value); mail is not sent until they are corrected
